blocks.source: Canto XXV
blocks.translation: Canto XXV

blocks.source: Al fine de le sue parole il ladro
blocks.translation: At the conclusion of his words, the thief

blocks.source: le mani alzò con amendue le fiche,
blocks.translation: Lifted his hands aloft with both the figs,

blocks.source: gridando: «Togli, Dio, ch’a te le squadro!».
blocks.translation: Crying: “Take that, God, for at thee I aim them.”

blocks.source: Da indi in qua mi fuor le serpi amiche,
blocks.translation: From that time forth the serpents were my friends;

blocks.source: perch’ una li s’avvolse allora al collo,
blocks.translation: For one entwined itself about his neck

blocks.source: come dicesse ‘Non vo’ che più diche’;
blocks.translation: As if it said: “I will not thou speak more;”

blocks.source: e un’altra a le braccia, e rilegollo,
blocks.translation: And round his arms another, and rebound him,

blocks.source: ribadendo sé stessa sì dinanzi,
blocks.translation: Clinching itself together so in front,

blocks.source: che non potea con esse dare un crollo.
blocks.translation: That with them he could not a motion make.

blocks.source: Ahi Pistoia, Pistoia, ché non stanzi
blocks.translation: Pistoia, ah, Pistoia! why resolve not

blocks.source: d’incenerarti sì che più non duri,
blocks.translation: To burn thyself to ashes and so perish,

blocks.source: poi che ’n mal fare il seme tuo avanzi?
blocks.translation: Since in ill-doing thou thy seed excellest?

blocks.source: Per tutt’ i cerchi de lo ’nferno scuri
blocks.translation: Through all the sombre circles of this Hell,

blocks.source: non vidi spirto in Dio tanto superbo,
blocks.translation: Spirit I saw not against God so proud,

blocks.source: non quel che cadde a Tebe giù da’ muri.
blocks.translation: Not he who fell at Thebes down from the walls!

blocks.source: El si fuggì che non parlò più verbo;
blocks.translation: He fled away, and spake no further word;

blocks.source: e io vidi un centauro pien di rabbia
blocks.translation: And I beheld a Centaur full of rage

blocks.source: venir chiamando: «Ov’ è, ov’ è l’acerbo?».
blocks.translation: Come crying out: “Where is, where is the scoffer?”

blocks.source: Maremma non cred’ io che tante n’abbia,
blocks.translation: I do not think Maremma has so many

blocks.source: quante bisce elli avea su per la groppa
blocks.translation: Serpents as he had all along his back,

blocks.source: infin ove comincia nostra labbia.
blocks.translation: As far as where our countenance begins.

blocks.source: Sovra le spalle, dietro da la coppa,
blocks.translation: Upon the shoulders, just behind the nape,

blocks.source: con l’ali aperte li giacea un draco;
blocks.translation: With wings wide open was a dragon lying,

blocks.source: e quello affuoca qualunque s’intoppa.
blocks.translation: And he sets fire to all that he encounters.

blocks.source: Lo mio maestro disse: «Questi è Caco,
blocks.translation: My Master said: “That one is Cacus, who

blocks.source: che, sotto ’l sasso di monte Aventino,
blocks.translation: Beneath the rock upon Mount Aventine

blocks.source: di sangue fece spesse volte laco.
blocks.translation: Created oftentimes a lake of blood.

blocks.source: Non va co’ suoi fratei per un cammino,
blocks.translation: He goes not on the same road with his brothers,

blocks.source: per lo furto che frodolente fece
blocks.translation: By reason of the fraudulent theft he made

blocks.source: del grande armento ch’elli ebbe a vicino;
blocks.translation: Of the great herd, which he had near to him;

blocks.source: onde cessar le sue opere biece
blocks.translation: Whereat his tortuous actions ceased beneath

blocks.source: sotto la mazza d’Ercule, che forse
blocks.translation: The mace of Hercules, who peradventure

blocks.source: gliene diè cento, e non sentì le diece».
blocks.translation: Gave him a hundred, and he felt not ten.”

blocks.source: Mentre che sì parlava, ed el trascorse,
blocks.translation: While he was speaking thus, he had passed by,

blocks.source: e tre spiriti venner sotto noi,
blocks.translation: And spirits three had underneath us come,

blocks.source: de’ quai né io né ’l duca mio s’accorse,
blocks.translation: Of which nor I aware was, nor my Leader,

blocks.source: se non quando gridar: «Chi siete voi?»;
blocks.translation: Until what time they shouted: “Who are you?”

blocks.source: per che nostra novella si ristette,
blocks.translation: On which account our story made a halt,

blocks.source: e intendemmo pur ad essi poi.
blocks.translation: And then we were intent on them alone.

blocks.source: Io non li conoscea; ma ei seguette,
blocks.translation: I did not know them; but it came to pass,

blocks.source: come suol seguitar per alcun caso,
blocks.translation: As it is wont to happen by some chance,

blocks.source: che l’un nomar un altro convenette,
blocks.translation: That one to name the other was compelled,

blocks.source: dicendo: «Cianfa dove fia rimaso?»;
blocks.translation: Exclaiming: “Where can Cianfa have remained?”

blocks.source: per ch’io, acciò che ’l duca stesse attento,
blocks.translation: Whence I, so that the Leader might attend,

blocks.source: mi puosi ’l dito su dal mento al naso.
blocks.translation: Upward from chin to nose my finger laid.

blocks.source: Se tu se’ or, lettore, a creder lento
blocks.translation: If thou art, Reader, slow now to believe

blocks.source: ciò ch’io dirò, non sarà maraviglia,
blocks.translation: What I shall say, it will no marvel be,

blocks.source: ché io che ’l vidi, a pena il mi consento.
blocks.translation: For I who saw it hardly can admit it.

blocks.source: Com’ io tenea levate in lor le ciglia,
blocks.translation: As I was holding raised on them my brows,

blocks.source: e un serpente con sei piè si lancia
blocks.translation: Behold! a serpent with six feet darts forth

blocks.source: dinanzi a l’uno, e tutto a lui s’appiglia.
blocks.translation: In front of one, and fastens wholly on him.

blocks.source: Co’ piè di mezzo li avvinse la pancia
blocks.translation: With middle feet it bound him round the paunch,

blocks.source: e con li anterïor le braccia prese;
blocks.translation: And with the forward ones his arms it seized;

blocks.source: poi li addentò e l’una e l’altra guancia;
blocks.translation: Then thrust its teeth through one cheek and the other;

blocks.source: li diretani a le cosce distese,
blocks.translation: The hindermost it stretched upon his thighs,

blocks.source: e miseli la coda tra ’mbedue
blocks.translation: And put its tail through in between the two,

blocks.source: e dietro per le ren sù la ritese.
blocks.translation: And up behind along the reins outspread it.

blocks.source: Ellera abbarbicata mai non fue
blocks.translation: Ivy was never fastened by its barbs

blocks.source: ad alber sì, come l’orribil fiera
blocks.translation: Unto a tree so, as this horrible reptile

blocks.source: per l’altrui membra avviticchiò le sue.
blocks.translation: Upon the other’s limbs entwined its own.

blocks.source: Poi s’appiccar, come di calda cera
blocks.translation: Then they stuck close, as if of heated wax

blocks.source: fossero stati, e mischiar lor colore,
blocks.translation: They had been made, and intermixed their colour;

blocks.source: né l’un né l’altro già parea quel ch’era:
blocks.translation: Nor one nor other seemed now what he was;

blocks.source: come procede innanzi da l’ardore,
blocks.translation: E’en as proceedeth on before the flame

blocks.source: per lo papiro suso, un color bruno
blocks.translation: Upward along the paper a brown colour,

blocks.source: che non è nero ancora e ’l bianco more.
blocks.translation: Which is not black as yet, and the white dies.

blocks.source: Li altri due ’l riguardavano, e ciascuno
blocks.translation: The other two looked on, and each of them

blocks.source: gridava: «Omè, Agnel, come ti muti!
blocks.translation: Cried out: “O me, Agnello, how thou changest!

blocks.source: Vedi che già non se’ né due né uno».
blocks.translation: Behold, thou now art neither two nor one.”

blocks.source: Già eran li due capi un divenuti,
blocks.translation: Already the two heads had one become,

blocks.source: quando n’apparver due figure miste
blocks.translation: When there appeared to us two figures mingled

blocks.source: in una faccia, ov’ eran due perduti.
blocks.translation: Into one face, wherein the two were lost.

blocks.source: Fersi le braccia due di quattro liste;
blocks.translation: Of the four lists were fashioned the two arms,

blocks.source: le cosce con le gambe e ’l ventre e ’l casso
blocks.translation: The thighs and legs, the belly and the chest

blocks.source: divenner membra che non fuor mai viste.
blocks.translation: Members became that never yet were seen.

blocks.source: Ogne primaio aspetto ivi era casso:
blocks.translation: Every original aspect there was cancelled;

blocks.source: due e nessun l’imagine perversa
blocks.translation: Two and yet none did the perverted image

blocks.source: parea; e tal sen gio con lento passo.
blocks.translation: Appear, and such departed with slow pace.

blocks.source: Come ’l ramarro sotto la gran fersa
blocks.translation: Even as a lizard, under the great scourge

blocks.source: dei dì canicular, cangiando sepe,
blocks.translation: Of days canicular, exchanging hedge,

blocks.source: folgore par se la via attraversa,
blocks.translation: Lightning appeareth if the road it cross;

blocks.source: sì pareva, venendo verso l’epe
blocks.translation: Thus did appear, coming towards the bellies

blocks.source: de li altri due, un serpentello acceso,
blocks.translation: Of the two others, a small fiery serpent,

blocks.source: livido e nero come gran di pepe;
blocks.translation: Livid and black as is a peppercorn.

blocks.source: e quella parte onde prima è preso
blocks.translation: And in that part whereat is first received

blocks.source: nostro alimento, a l’un di lor trafisse;
blocks.translation: Our aliment, it one of them transfixed;

blocks.source: poi cadde giuso innanzi lui disteso.
blocks.translation: Then downward fell in front of him extended.

blocks.source: Lo trafitto ’l mirò, ma nulla disse;
blocks.translation: The one transfixed looked at it, but said naught;

blocks.source: anzi, co’ piè fermati, sbadigliava
blocks.translation: Nay, rather with feet motionless he yawned,

blocks.source: pur come sonno o febbre l’assalisse.
blocks.translation: Just as if sleep or fever had assailed him.

blocks.source: Elli ’l serpente e quei lui riguardava;
blocks.translation: He at the serpent gazed, and it at him;

blocks.source: l’un per la piaga e l’altro per la bocca
blocks.translation: One through the wound, the other through the mouth

blocks.source: fummavan forte, e ’l fummo si scontrava.
blocks.translation: Smoked violently, and the smoke commingled.

blocks.source: Taccia Lucano ormai là dov’ e’ tocca
blocks.translation: Henceforth be silent Lucan, where he mentions

blocks.source: del misero Sabello e di Nasidio,
blocks.translation: Wretched Sabellus and Nassidius,

blocks.source: e attenda a udir quel ch’or si scocca.
blocks.translation: And wait to hear what now shall be shot forth.

blocks.source: Taccia di Cadmo e d’Aretusa Ovidio,
blocks.translation: Be silent Ovid, of Cadmus and Arethusa;

blocks.source: ché se quello in serpente e quella in fonte
blocks.translation: For if him to a snake, her to fountain,

blocks.source: converte poetando, io non lo ’nvidio;
blocks.translation: Converts he fabling, that I grudge him not;

blocks.source: ché due nature mai a fronte a fronte
blocks.translation: Because two natures never front to front

blocks.source: non trasmutò sì ch’amendue le forme
blocks.translation: Has he transmuted, so that both the forms

blocks.source: a cambiar lor matera fosser pronte.
blocks.translation: To interchange their matter ready were.

blocks.source: Insieme si rispuosero a tai norme,
blocks.translation: Together they responded in such wise,

blocks.source: che ’l serpente la coda in forca fesse,
blocks.translation: That to a fork the serpent cleft his tail,

blocks.source: e ’l feruto ristrinse insieme l’orme.
blocks.translation: And eke the wounded drew his feet together.

blocks.source: Le gambe con le cosce seco stesse
blocks.translation: The legs together with the thighs themselves

blocks.source: s’appiccar sì, che ’n poco la giuntura
blocks.translation: Adhered so, that in little time the juncture

blocks.source: non facea segno alcun che si paresse.
blocks.translation: No sign whatever made that was apparent.

blocks.source: Togliea la coda fessa la figura
blocks.translation: He with the cloven tail assumed the figure

blocks.source: che si perdeva là, e la sua pelle
blocks.translation: The other one was losing, and his skin

blocks.source: si facea molle, e quella di là dura.
blocks.translation: Became elastic, and the other’s hard.

blocks.source: Io vidi intrar le braccia per l’ascelle,
blocks.translation: I saw the arms draw inward at the armpits,

blocks.source: e i due piè de la fiera, ch’eran corti,
blocks.translation: And both feet of the reptile, that were short,

blocks.source: tanto allungar quanto accorciavan quelle.
blocks.translation: Lengthen as much as those contracted were.

blocks.source: Poscia li piè di rietro, insieme attorti,
blocks.translation: Thereafter the hind feet, together twisted,

blocks.source: diventaron lo membro che l’uom cela,
blocks.translation: Became the member that a man conceals,

blocks.source: e ’l misero del suo n’avea due porti.
blocks.translation: And of his own the wretch had two created.

blocks.source: Mentre che ’l fummo l’uno e l’altro vela
blocks.translation: While both of them the exhalation veils

blocks.source: di color novo, e genera ’l pel suso
blocks.translation: With a new colour, and engenders hair

blocks.source: per l’una parte e da l’altra il dipela,
blocks.translation: On one of them and depilates the other,

blocks.source: l’un si levò e l’altro cadde giuso,
blocks.translation: The one uprose and down the other fell,

blocks.source: non torcendo però le lucerne empie,
blocks.translation: Though turning not away their impious lamps,

blocks.source: sotto le quai ciascun cambiava muso.
blocks.translation: Underneath which each one his muzzle changed.

blocks.source: Quel ch’era dritto, il trasse ver’ le tempie,
blocks.translation: He who was standing drew it tow’rds the temples,

blocks.source: e di troppa matera ch’in là venne
blocks.translation: And from excess of matter, which came thither,

blocks.source: uscir li orecchi de le gote scempie;
blocks.translation: Issued the ears from out the hollow cheeks;

blocks.source: ciò che non corse in dietro e si ritenne
blocks.translation: What did not backward run and was retained

blocks.source: di quel soverchio, fé naso a la faccia
blocks.translation: Of that excess made to the face a nose,

blocks.source: e le labbra ingrossò quanto convenne.
blocks.translation: And the lips thickened far as was befitting.

blocks.source: Quel che giacëa, il muso innanzi caccia,
blocks.translation: He who lay prostrate thrusts his muzzle forward,

blocks.source: e li orecchi ritira per la testa
blocks.translation: And backward draws the ears into his head,

blocks.source: come face le corna la lumaccia;
blocks.translation: In the same manner as the snail its horns;

blocks.source: e la lingua, ch’avëa unita e presta
blocks.translation: And so the tongue, which was entire and apt

blocks.source: prima a parlar, si fende, e la forcuta
blocks.translation: For speech before, is cleft, and the bi-forked

blocks.source: ne l’altro si richiude; e ’l fummo resta.
blocks.translation: In the other closes up, and the smoke ceases.

blocks.source: L’anima ch’era fiera divenuta,
blocks.translation: The soul, which to a reptile had been changed,

blocks.source: suffolando si fugge per la valle,
blocks.translation: Along the valley hissing takes to flight,

blocks.source: e l’altro dietro a lui parlando sputa.
blocks.translation: And after him the other speaking sputters.

blocks.source: Poscia li volse le novelle spalle,
blocks.translation: Then did he turn upon him his new shoulders,

blocks.source: e disse a l’altro: «I’ vo’ che Buoso corra,
blocks.translation: And said to the other: “I’ll have Buoso run,

blocks.source: com’ ho fatt’ io, carpon per questo calle».
blocks.translation: Crawling as I have done, along this road.”

blocks.source: Così vid’ io la settima zavorra
blocks.translation: In this way I beheld the seventh ballast

blocks.source: mutare e trasmutare; e qui mi scusi
blocks.translation: Shift and reshift, and here be my excuse

blocks.source: la novità se fior la penna abborra.
blocks.translation: The novelty, if aught my pen transgress.

blocks.source: E avvegna che li occhi miei confusi
blocks.translation: And notwithstanding that mine eyes might be

blocks.source: fossero alquanto e l’animo smagato,
blocks.translation: Somewhat bewildered, and my mind dismayed,

blocks.source: non poter quei fuggirsi tanto chiusi,
blocks.translation: They could not flee away so secretly

blocks.source: ch’i’ non scorgessi ben Puccio Sciancato;
blocks.translation: But that I plainly saw Puccio Sciancato;

blocks.source: ed era quel che sol, di tre compagni
blocks.translation: And he it was who sole of three companions,

blocks.source: che venner prima, non era mutato;
blocks.translation: Which came in the beginning, was not changed;

blocks.source: l’altr’ era quel che tu, Gaville, piagni.
blocks.translation: The other was he whom thou, Gaville, weepest.
